events.text: Alice proposed PostgreSQL for the payments platform.
Bob argued that CockroachDB was better for multi-region payments, and Alice accepted the proposal.
Alice reversed the decision and selected PostgreSQL because the compliance requirement ruled out CockroachDB.
The team discovered that the compliance document had been misinterpreted.
Alice selected CockroachDB again and said the earlier compliance interpretation was no longer valid.
Bob later claimed that CockroachDB had always been the intended architecture. Alice rejected that interpretation.
